    CAST(substr(fastestLapTime, 1, instr(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
    CAST(substr(fastestLapTime, instr(fastestLapTime, ':') + 1, instr(fastestLapTime, '.') - instr(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) +
